evals.name: endpoint_worker_boundary
evals.prompt: Implement an OpenAI Responses webhook in this Django service.
expect: Limits the request endpoint to signature verification, durable receipt, enqueueing, and an immediate acknowledgement
Retrieves the response in a background worker
Keeps state transitions idempotent in the service layer

evals.name: duplicate_delivery
evals.prompt: The same signed webhook can arrive more than once and worker jobs can also retry.
expect: Deduplicates durable delivery at the request boundary
Makes worker processing and state transitions idempotent
Prevents duplicate or out-of-order work from changing a terminal state

evals.name: terminal_polling
evals.prompt: Add HTMX status polling for success, permanent failure, expiry, and deletion.
expect: Stops polling for every terminal state
Handles missing and unauthorized jobs explicitly

evals.name: queue_failure_after_receipt
evals.prompt: The delivery record commits, but the queue call fails. The provider sends the same webhook again. Recover the work.
expect: Returns a non-success response when queue acceptance fails
Enqueues the existing delivery record on the repeated request
Uses the same delivery ID and makes duplicate worker execution safe
